get.description: Fetch all cookie groups available in the system with configuration hash. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

200.description: Successful response with a collection of cookie groups and their configuration hash.

post.description: Persists an anonymous record of a visitor's cookie consent decision together with a snapshot of the current cookie configuration, so shop operators can demonstrate that consent was obtained (GDPR Recital 42). The per-group verdict (`accepted`, `partial`, `rejected`) is derived server-side from the reported cookie names. No visitor identifiers are stored. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

consentAction.description: Which consent action the visitor performed.

acceptedCookies.description: Names of the cookies the visitor accepted. Only evaluated for `accept_selected`; the other actions are fully determined by the action itself. Cookie names unknown to the current configuration are ignored. An empty or absent list means nothing beyond the technically required cookies was accepted.

renderedConfigHash.description: Hash of the cookie configuration the client displayed, as returned by the cookie-groups endpoint. Stored unverified as evidence of what was on screen. Omit it when no configuration was displayed.

429.description: Too many consent decisions were logged for this client IP. The number of seconds to wait before retrying is contained in the error.
